    Past Perfect or Past Perfect Continuous?

    Past Perfect — the result, how many, finished.

    By 6 am the officers had checked twelve cameras.

    We count the result: twelve cameras, three rooms, two reports.

    Past Perfect Continuous — the activity, how long.

    By 6 am the officers had been checking cameras for five hours.

    We talk about the time: for five hours, since midnight, all night. That's why they were tired.

    Moscow file: the Kremlin clockThe clock on the Spasskaya Tower is the most famous clock in Russia. The Butenop brothers made the present clock in 1851–1852. Before that, the tower had had several other clocks. Every New Year's Eve, while millions of people are watching TV, it strikes twelve.

    Moscow file: Red SquareIn old Russian, the word krasnaya used to mean "beautiful", not "red". St Basil's Cathedral was built in 1555–1561: Ivan the Terrible ordered it after his army had taken Kazan.

    The big case

    The missing painting

    Last night someone stole the painting Winter Firebird from a Moscow museum. The lights are off. Move your flashlight over the room (mouse or finger) and find seven clues.

    0 / 7 clues

    CluesSOLVED
    Real cases from a Moscow museumSOLVED

    Strange days at the Tretyakov Gallery

    The Tretyakov Gallery is one of the most famous art museums in Moscow. Pavel Tretyakov, a rich merchant, had been collecting Russian paintings for almost forty years before he gave his collection to the city in 1892.

    The museum has seen some strange crimes. In May 2018 a visitor attacked Ilya Repin's famous painting Ivan the Terrible and His Son Ivan with a metal pole. The glass broke and the canvas was badly damaged. It wasn't the first attack: a man had cut the same painting with a knife back in 1913.

    In January 2019, while visitors were walking around the halls, a man took Arkhip Kuindzhi's painting Ai-Petri. Crimea off the wall and simply walked out with it. Nobody stopped him. The next day the police found the painting at a building site outside Moscow and arrested the thief.

    True, false, or the text doesn't say?

    Remember

    Past Simple — finished: he took. Past Continuous — in progress: he was taking. used to — old habits: he used to take.

    Past Perfect — earlier: he had taken. Past Perfect Continuous — earlier, for some time: he had been taking.
